Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Gleam's milestone confetti pop - a party popper emoji on an onboarding screen bursts a cloud of colored confetti that spreads, tumbles, and rains down around the "You're halfway there!" message.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
A cream onboarding screen with an orange progress bar and CTA: centered, a party popper emoji above the headline "You're halfway there!" and a line of supporting copy.

## Motion spec
Pattern: single confetti burst with gravity, ~1.6s of particle life.
- Pop: the popper emoji scales 1 -> 1.3 -> 1 (spring ~380/15, 300ms) as the burst fires from its tip.
- Burst: ~40 confetti pieces (squares, circles, and strips in red, blue, teal, orange) launch radially upward and outward (spread cone ~120deg, initial velocity staggered), each with random rotation.
- Fall: pieces decelerate at the top, then drift down with gravity, swaying side to side (sinusoidal wobble ~10px) and tumbling; they fade out individually over the last 400ms of their ~1.6s life.
- Text and CTA stay put; confetti renders above them.

## Calibration
- One burst per milestone view - it does not loop.
- Pieces must clear the headline on the way up, then rain past it.

## Reduced motion
The popper does its scale pop; confetti is replaced by a single sparkle fade.

## Don't miss
- Mixed particle shapes and colors - not uniform dots.
- The wobble and tumble continue during the fall, not just on launch.
